t: You are in Piccadilly Circus tube station, looking at a memorial called Beauty < Immortality. It commemorates Frank Pick, a British transport administrator. Pick qualified as a solicitor in 1902, then worked at the North Eastern Railway before joining the Underground Electric Railways Company of London in 1906. When the London Passenger Transport Board was created in 1933, he became its chief executive and vice-chairman, and he held those posts until 1940. It is fitting that his memorial sits inside the Underground network he helped to run.
